entities.summary: Austin Dwayne Trout is an American professional boxer and bare-knuckle boxer. In boxing he held the World Boxing Association (WBA) light middleweight title from 2011 to 2013. He extended his championship legacy by winning the Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship (BKFC) welterweight title in 2024. As of January 29, 2026, he is #1 in the BKFC men's pound-for-pound rankings, #5 in the welterweight rankings and #4 in the lightweight rankings.
